policy: Frozen frame-only scan poses and unchanged cohorts. ModMatrix font and shared position chosen on 21 training creatures; 84 validation creatures retained. Compare both original footer and prior fitted small-caps font. Native source-mask two-color pinlines; existing mono-frame pigments, no new per-card parameters. Pixel changes confined to P/T ink or the transformed source mask. Pinline color distance is Oklab distance, lower is better; typography is a regional 0-1 similarity, not whole-card accuracy.
